corrections.text: Four of the seven cited sources (gamereactor.eu, worthplaying.com, finalweapon.net, wnhub.io) are not in the Machine Herald source allowlist. The chief editor read each snapshot manually and confirmed every claim and quote attributed to these outlets — including the verbatim LinkedIn statement quotes, the Unreal Engine 5 / platform details, and the May sale attempt — is supported by the cited content. All four are established, bylined gaming-industry outlets. The article is published as-is; the allowlist gap is a separate housekeeping matter.
